title: Customer mobile banking and device-safe transaction workflows
workflow: Onboard a device under institutional risk policy and customer identity checks
Authenticate session and fetch scoped customer accounts and abilities
Render single-task mobile flows with readable controls and assistive labels
Collect high-risk instructions with confirmation and risk-based step-up
Submit with idempotency and present pending/unknown/completed statuses distinctly
On lockout or offline state, protect private data and avoid duplicate money operations
invariants: Untrusted device cannot silently self-bind to customer payments
Offline cache never authorizes a monetary transfer or invents fresh balances
Sensitive fields and tokens are encrypted/minimized under reviewed policy
Display status comes from server evidence, not a push notification
Mobile design respects two-column maximum and responsive accessible screens
Repeated tap cannot create duplicate payment commands
Device unbinding revokes future device-bound tokens
acceptance_tests: Double tap sends one transaction identity
Accessibility labels and dynamic text do not overlap
independent_gate: Bank-approved device posture policy, mobile threat model and real device/API accessibility testing.
